title: 3 Types of Irony — Verbal, Situational, and Dramatic Irony
skills: distinguish among verbal, situational, and dramatic irony
identify examples of each type of irony
analyze how irony shapes meaning and audience response
explain how authors use irony for humor, tension, or emphasis
alignment_note: Provides an overview of verbal, situational, and dramatic irony and explains how each functions differently in a text. Supports literary-device recognition, close reading, comparison of authorial techniques, and evidence-based analysis across high school English courses.
